project_type: Full-stack Go + React community app (bbs-go fork)
build_system: Makefile with pnpm for web, go build for backend
test_framework: Go tests (go test ./...), pnpm typecheck + pnpm lint for web
build_command: make check (runs go test, typecheck, lint) or individually: cd web && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint
test_command: cd web && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'cd web && pnpm typecheck' to check TypeScript types. 2. Run 'cd web && pnpm lint' for linting. 3. Run 'go build ./...' from project root to verify Go compiles.
setup_instructions: 1. cd web && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile. 2. Go modules already vendored or downloaded.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. No database available for runtime testing, but build/compile verification works.
contribution_requirements: Standard Go + React conventions. i18n keys in both en-US.ts and zh-CN.ts. Routes follow file-based routing with react-router.
key_patterns: Frontend: React 19 with useEffect+useState for data fetching, react-router file-based routes, Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn UI components, lucide-react icons, sonner for toasts, i18next with useI18n() hook. Backend: Gin router, services layer, repositories layer, handlers/api for API endpoints, render package for response building.
directory_structure: web/ - React frontend (app/routes for pages, components/, lib/api, lib/i18n). internal/ - Go backend (handlers/api, services, models, server/router.go). Makefile at root.
